citation.title: Highest fusion performance without harmful edge energy bursts in tokamak
citation.authors: S. K. Kim, R. Shousha, S. M. Yang, Q. Hu, et al. (incl. E. Kolemen)
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1038/s41467-024-48415-w (printed in the source's own running header)

topic: Adaptive RMP amplitude control using Dα ELM detection, plus an MLP surrogate of GPEC for 3D-coil configuration, applied on DIII-D and KSTAR.
own_question: Can real-time adaptive and ML-surrogate 3D-field optimization sustain ELM suppression while recovering confinement?
actual_method_and_evidence: Dα-based feedback on RMP amplitude, and an MLP trained on GPEC outputs from 8490 KSTAR equilibria with a random 6790/1700 split (reported test R2 of 0.91). CES carbon (6+) Ti and rotation pedestal heights come from offline tanh fits to profiles averaged over 50 ms. These measurements are used only for post-hoc interpretation, not as a control input or a nowcasting target.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In RMP ELM-control studies, CES carbon-impurity pedestal Ti and rotation are used offline to interpret confinement changes.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.8 Methods (kinetic profiles); p.4 Fig.6 caption; p.7 Fig.9 caption
claim_checks.qualification: The measured quantity is carbon impurity Ti, not main-ion Ti. Profiles are averaged over 50 ms and processed offline. The paper does not use CES in real time.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: The control inputs are the Dα signal and real-time equilibrium. The ML-3D surrogate outputs coil-configuration parameters every 1 ms. CES report arrival timing is not described.
validation_if_relevant: The surrogate uses a single random split of time slices; whether shots are held out is unknown. The control demonstrations are experimental discharges.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim the paper nowcasts or predicts CES temperature.
Do not cite it as evidence of BES/ECEI value for Ti estimation.
Do not cite the 1 ms surrogate timing as relevant to a 10 ms CES estimator.
Do not treat the rotation-hysteresis account as a demonstrated physical mechanism.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional motivation only: it shows KSTAR pedestal Ti and rotation being analyzed during adaptive RMP control. It does not establish a real-time need for CES estimates, so it is not needed for the core framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
